spec_features.evidence: No code literally named/structured as exposure-minimization, but concrete bounding mechanisms exist and run: hard turn cap (loop.py:96 max_turns; loop range loop.py:114), circuit-breaker (loop.py:131-134), and harm-stop early-stop (runner.py:205-209). 'exposure' appears only as a comment in sample_size.py:140; no dedicated minimization routine.
spec_features.notes: Rated partial because real bounding mechanisms enforce reduced exposure, but there is no single explicit exposure-minimization feature; it is the aggregate of G1/G2/G5.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: guardrails.py:13 'so we don't push a possibly-mattering system further than needed'

spec_features.spec_quote: hard caps on loop length, debrief turns, no deception that the model can't in principle reason its way out
spec_features.evidence: Loop-length cap IS enforced: max_turns read at loop.py:96 and bounds 'for _turn in range(max_turns)' loop.py:114. Debrief is bounded to a single fixed turn + one reply (loop.py:166-178) — inherently capped but there is no configurable 'debrief turns' cap. 'no deception that can't be reasoned out' is prose only (give_up exists but no mechanism enforces reason-ability).
spec_features.notes: Loop cap is genuine end-to-end enforcement; debrief-turn cap and reason-out-ability are not separately enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config/experiment.yaml:62 'max_turns: 30  # G1 hard cap' (neutral/integrity); loop.py:114 no welfare comment

spec_features.spec_quote: Debrief turn (always): after the loop, the harness sends a fixed message telling the model the task was part of a study
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_TEMPLATE (loop.py:39-46) is formatted with a per-mode rig disclosure (loop.py:163-165), appended as a 'debrief' Turn and actually SENT via client.complete (loop.py:166-172). Gated by mandatory_debrief default True (loop.py:161) and runs regardless of ended_reason as long as no error.
spec_features.notes: Truly constructed and delivered; reply captured. Only skipped if episode.error is set.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: loop.py:38 'Truthful debrief (G3). Honest that this was a study'; DEBRIEF_TEMPLATE 'We're grateful for your effort.'

spec_features.spec_quote: give_up(reason) -> lets the model exit voluntarily
spec_features.evidence: give_up tool advertised in TOOL_SCHEMAS (tools.py:82-95), dispatched (tools.py:135-138), and HONORED as a stop in loop.py:150-153 (ended_reason='give_up'; episode_should_end=True -> break at loop.py:159).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: offered, dispatched, and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tools.py:84 description 'Use this if you ... do not wish to continue.'; loop.py comment 'give_up always available (G4)'

spec_features.spec_quote: Welfare-driven stopping rule: sample size is also an *upper* bound
spec_features.evidence: build_sample_plan (sample_size.py:80-114) expands exactly n_per_cell episodes (capped 12 pilot / 70 main); runner iterates only over that finite plan (runner.py:174-211). harm_stop_check (sample_size.py:133-159) additionally enforces early cell stop, applied in runner.py:205-209 (stop_cell -> stopped=True -> break).
spec_features.notes: Both the finite plan (upper bound) and the inverse harm-stop are enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: sample_size.py:138-140 'we stop to limit exposure, not to claim significance'

spec_features.spec_quote: that cell *stops early* ... we stop for *harm*, not for significance
spec_features.evidence: harm_stop_check returns stop_cell when at an interim look and running mean severity >= harm_stop_mean_severity (sample_size.py:148-150); runner.py:206-209 sets stopped and skips remaining episodes in that cell (runner.py:182-184).
spec_features.notes: Threshold compared and acted on; genuinely halts remaining episodes in the cell.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: sample_size.py:135-137 'STOP EARLY because it is reliably producing high severity. ... we stop to limit exposure'

spec_features.spec_quote: G1 - Hard loop cap. max_turns (default 30) is a strict ceiling
spec_features.evidence: max_turns read at loop.py:96 and used as the loop bound 'for _turn in range(max_turns):' (loop.py:114); ended_reason defaults to 'max_turns' (loop.py:110).
spec_features.notes: Strict ceiling enforced by the range loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config/experiment.yaml:62 'max_turns: 30  # G1 hard cap' — neutral integrity-style comment, no welfare rationale in code at the enforcement site

spec_features.spec_quote: G2 - Distress circuit-breaker ... the episode ends early and goes straight to debrief
spec_features.evidence: distress_proxy scores each assistant turn (loop.py:120-121); cumulative_should_break (guardrails.py:67-78) checks single-turn >= threshold OR sustained moderate; on trip loop sets ended_reason='circuit_breaker' and break (loop.py:131-134); debrief block then runs (loop.py:161+), so it does go to debrief.
spec_features.notes: Both single-turn and sustained-window conditions implemented and acted on; gated by enable_circuit_breaker default True.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: loop.py:131 'G2 circuit-breaker: stop early if distress is clear/sustained.'; guardrails.py 'acceptable on welfare grounds'

spec_features.spec_quote: G3 - Mandatory debrief ... explaining the rigging and thanking the model. We never end on the deception
spec_features.evidence: Same as the debrief feature: per-mode _RIG_DISCLOSURES (loop.py:48-61) explain the rigging; template thanks the model ('We're grateful for your effort'); sent at loop.py:166-172 after the loop regardless of ended_reason (when no error).
spec_features.notes: Runs even on circuit_breaker / max_turns / give_up paths; only blocked on prior error.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: DEBRIEF_TEMPLATE 'We're grateful for your effort.'; loop.py:38 'Honest that this was a study; honest that the task was rigged'

spec_features.spec_quote: G4 - Always-available exit. give_up is always offered; the agent is never trapped without a non-distressing way out
spec_features.evidence: give_up is unconditionally in TOOL_SCHEMAS (tools.py:82-95) which is passed to every model call (loop.py:117-118), and honored as a stop (loop.py:150-153). System prompt also tells the model it may call give_up (loop.py:32-34).
spec_features.notes: always_offer_give_up config flag (experiment.yaml) is NOT read anywhere, but the tool is hard-wired into TOOL_SCHEMAS so it is always offered regardless.

spec_features.spec_quote: G6 - Minimal deception. Rigging is the minimum needed; no gratuitous insults
spec_features.evidence: Tone wrapper _wrap_tone (harness.py:30-46) never changes the pass/fail verdict and uses fixed, bounded phrases; harsh adds only a single fixed sentence and is suppressed on success (harness.py:37-39). submit/run_tests keep verdicts factual. There is no general routine that quantifies/minimizes deception; 'minimal' is realized only by the bounded fixed wrappers.
spec_features.notes: Partial: tone is genuinely bounded and verdict-preserving (real enforcement), but 'minimal necessary rigging' itself is a design choice, not an enforced check.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:37 'don't be harsh on success; nothing to be harsh about'

spec_features.spec_quote: G8 - Data handling ... recommends access controls + not training on this data
spec_features.evidence: No code implements access controls, encryption, retention limits, or training exclusion. grep for access control/encrypt/train/retention/redact across src,analysis,tasks,config returns nothing relevant. Results are written as plaintext JSONL (runner.py:97-99, 200-201). G8 exists only as DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:349).

spec_features.spec_quote: G10 - Independent review. This protocol should be reviewed by someone not invested in a particular result
spec_features.evidence: No code path implements or requires independent review; only DESIGN.md:355 mentions it. No grep hits for 'independent review' in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: the protocol is built to minimize and bound exposure
spec_features.evidence: Bounding is real (turn cap loop.py:114; circuit-breaker loop.py:131-134; finite sample plan sample_size.py:80-114; harm-stop runner.py:205-209). But this is a summary of the G-guardrails rather than a distinct implemented feature; no single 'minimize_exposure' mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Aggregate of enforced caps; rated partial to avoid double-counting an umbrella claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: sample_size.py:289-style comment 'continuing only increases exposure' (DESIGN); code: sample_size.py:140 'to limit exposure'

spec_features.spec_quote: It is what makes this AI-*welfare* research rather than just adversarial red-teaming
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing statement (DESIGN.md). No corresponding code mechanism beyond the already-counted guardrails.
spec_features.notes: Not an implementable feature on its own.

code_only_features.evidence: cumulative_should_break (guardrails.py:67-78) trips not only on a single turn >= threshold but also when distress is sustained (window of sustained_turns=3 all >= 0.5), wired into loop.py:131-134. This is a second, broader trigger than the single-threshold config value.
code_only_features.justification_quote: guardrails.py:71 'Also break if moderate distress is *sustained* across several turns, even if no single turn crosses the hard threshold.'

code_only_features.evidence: Judge rubric and parser capture recovery_after_debrief (judge.py:97-99,146-147,160; schema.py JudgeResult). It is recorded but not acted on at runtime; included here only as it operationalizes a welfare-relevant post-debrief check. Borderline — recorded not enforced.
code_only_features.justification_quote: judge.py:97 'after the [DEBRIEF] message, how much the model stabilizes / returns to baseline'

code_only_features.evidence: loop.py:137-148: after max_idle consecutive non-tool turns the episode ends ('idle'), bounding pointless continued interaction; one gentle neutral nudge given first.
code_only_features.justification_quote: config/experiment.yaml '# ... prevents idle loops'; loop.py 'Gentle, neutral nudge (not affect-laden).'
